name: tinymvc/tinyqr
description: Lightweight PHP QR code generator and decoder with PNG and SVG output.

suggest.ext-gd: Required to decode raster images; matrix decoding does not need GD.
suggest.ext-mbstring: Enables decoding Kanji and Shift-JIS byte segments (or use ext-iconv).
suggest.ext-iconv: Alternative to ext-mbstring for decoding Kanji and Shift-JIS byte segments.
